queries.evidence_ja: あの安らかななつかしみと許しの日
queries.reason: 安らかな is an adjective modifying 日 ("that peaceful ... day"), modifying the day whose content is nostalgia and forgiveness. Rendering it as a noun coordinated with them ("{t:rest} nostalgia and forgiveness") breaks the grammar of the phrase and conflates the 安らかさ chord with 安息/rest.
queries.say: The peaceful adjective on 'day' has become a third noun in the list.
queries.span: there is {t:that-day} of {t:rest} nostalgia and forgiveness
queries.suggested_fix: there is that peaceful day of nostalgia and forgiveness

queries.evidence_ja: 俺たちはいろ〳〵苦労したなァ
queries.reason: いろいろ ("all sorts of, various") is dropped, flattening his count of the three years into a general "a lot of troubles"; the variety of hardships is part of what the couple keep enumerating (cf. 種々のこと in p23).
queries.say: いろいろ in his "we've suffered" is not carried over.
queries.span: we have been through a lot of troubles
queries.suggested_fix: we have been through all sorts of troubles

queries.evidence_ja: なにか大きな、彼女にはわからないけれども、なにか大きな希《のぞ》みを彼に話さなければならないやうに
queries.reason: The Japanese repeats なにか大きな around 希み ("some great hope"), an incantatory doubling the reading asks to keep. The English repeats "some great" only in varied form — "some great hope" then "what great thing it was" — swapping 希み/hope for the flat "thing" on its second occurrence, breaking the repetition and thinning the word the passage is reaching for.
queries.say: The repeated "some great hope" is varied away to "great thing" the second time.
queries.span: though she did not herself know what great thing it was
queries.suggested_fix: though she did not herself know what great hope it was

data.say: Page checked against the crux; two real queries (the 安らかな adjective made a noun at p20, the varied "great hope" repetition at p27) plus one minor omission, the rest clean.
